data.name: Window_Title
data.value: Set up ONNX extractive question answering

data.name: Step1_Description
data.value: Python is required to download and export the example model. Download the latest release here and enable “Add Python to PATH” during setup: {0}

data.name: Step2_Headline
data.value: Export the multilingual mDeBERTa-v3 QA model

data.name: Step2_Description
data.value: Open the included page and run or download the published Python script. It uses multilingual mDeBERTa-v3 by default. Pass --model-id for another checkpoint, --model-root-directory for a user model root, or --output-directory for an exact model folder: {0}

data.name: Step3_Description
data.value: ModelFolder points to the QA model root option and default model subfolder. The folder must contain model.onnx, config.json, tokenizer_config.json and the exported tokenizer assets. Enable AllowNoAnswer when empty answers are required and tune its threshold with representative data.
